summary: Register Instagram professional-account Content Publishing as a Social Core provider with exact account binding, Task-088 media revalidation, host-owned ephemeral HTTPS staging, image/carousel/Reels publication and fail-closed write ambiguity.

impacts.evidence: One tenant-bound Account resolves one exact numeric Instagram professional-account ID; health, publish and status receipts cannot override or cross that binding.
OAuth token bytes stay callback-scoped. Released media is revalidated through Task-088 and only a short-lived host-staged HTTPS retrieval URL crosses the provider boundary.
Task 043 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP/OpenAPI operation.
Task 043 consumes existing Task-020 SocialPublisher and SocialPublicationStatusReader interfaces; frozen Connector/Runtime SDK-v1 roots and capability registry are unchanged.
No migration is added; provider configuration and transient media/container identities remain host/provider boundary data.

Egress authority is fixed to graph.instagram.com; credentials use SecretAccessor; media is current-release revalidated; staging URLs are HTTPS/443, bounded and excluded from normalized results/errors.
Publishing remains dispatched only from canonical Task-020 READY state. Text-only, Stories, edit/delete and unqualified provider surfaces remain undeclared.
Task-020 remains owner of Content/Variant/Publication/audit/outbox evidence; the adapter returns bounded remote IDs/status only.
Remote identity is bound to configured IG user. Ambiguous POST transport/5xx outcomes fail closed as non-retryable write_outcome_unknown rather than risking duplicate publication.
Only outbound graph.instagram.com API calls and host-owned short-lived media staging are admitted; webhook subscription is not part of Task 043.
Auth, permission, rate-limit, media-processing/rejection and remote availability errors are normalized without raw Meta messages, tokens or signed staging URLs.
Suspend the Instagram connector account and revoke its OAuth grant/staging authority to stop new publication; no schema rollback is required.
Deterministic tests cover manifest/account auth, Task-088 media staging, JPEG/MP4 limits, container readiness, write ambiguity and exact status binding; Task-064 passes all thirteen checks.
